name: Angelos' Heptades
desc: A golden box as splendid as the light of the heavens. According to legend, it once belonged to a divine envoy of the Eternal Court.

desc.text:
Once upon a time, the mother of roses and lilies graced the girl's silken swaddling with a violet perfume, to ensure that an endless stream of joyous dreams might ward off death's bitter gloom.
The beautiful songstress, who once plucked elegant melodies, also bathed her wings in the warm, gentle waters of compassion, for the precious newborn was never meant to be touched by the music of the world's mundane strings.
This was a time when the chains of eternity had yet to be shattered, and when carefree refrains could still be heard before the throne of the heavens.
It was a time when the days beneath the silver-white tree were as sweet as honey, and glorious messengers thronged the primordial paradise.
In a rich, golden dream steeped in the warmth of the spring sun, the innocent child basked in the doting love of all her sisters.
In their cradle of tender Azurelight, they shared laughter with the morning dew and new-blown buds;
and by the black stone that had yet to fall, they sang soft tunes to the fading sunset and quiet evening breeze.
Their bright eyes had never witnessed the spilled crimson in the world below, nor had their slender hands ever touched the sad pain of injustice.
Then, starlight from beyond put an end to that bucolic idyll, and the bonfire of disobedience was kindled by misguided desire.
The eldest daughter who dared overstep met her end, plummeting from the mountain peak, while the armored emissaries who swore to strike down the Lord of Hosts perished one after another.
All this time, the youngest child, the most beloved of them all, was hidden far away, in a palace deep within the wilds, sequestered from the storm of violence and the relentless rain of blood.
"I shall overthrow the throne of the Most High, to set the oppressed free, and to avenge the afflicted."
"But as for our sister, who is young and tender, we shall not harden her heart to make war against the false lord."
"Whether we prevail or fall, it is not right that her wings should bear the heavy yoke which we ourselves ought to bear."
While no one knew the capricious ruler's desire, their righteous rule still afforded one the chance to choose one's path.
And choose the youngest did, to cast off the divinity and her former powers. Then, miraculously, this child was allowed to retain human form.
Thus did she step into the world of the mortals, with nothing more than her broken wings and a fragile body of flesh and bone.
In this utterly vulnerable form, she wandered alone through a land filled with sorrow and tears, tainting her once pristine feet with muck and mire.
This went on for thousands of years, in which countless towers turned to sand, and songs of lament dissipated into the night breeze.
The envoy who wandered, the envoy who met the witch, the envoy who at last was relieved of the past...
Through the journey and memories that belonged to her alone, she found her crown irreplaceable at last.
The world she had never once deigned to behold was now etched forever in her eyes, the eyes of one who can no longer sing.
And so the solitary guide now stands, her crown wrought from the countless joys and sorrows of men, and the grand adventures of mortal heroes.
"What a beautiful world this is!"

customize.name: Angelos' Heptades

customize.name: Athame Artis
customize.desc: A precious sword gifted by the Day King to the brave hero in the little witch's story, only for the witch to take it and defeat the hero herself.

customize.name: Mitternachts Waltz
customize.desc: A bow painted the color of transgression and nights of illusion.

customize.name: Moonweaver's Dawn
customize.desc: An immaculate, sharp silver sword that can slice through armor like moonlight flowing through the empty night. According to legend, it is a divine blade, blessed by the first Moonchanter herself.

customize.name: The Widsith
customize.desc: A heavy notebook filled with musical scores. Though suffering from moth damage and heavy wear-and-tear, there is still much power to be found among the hand-written words within.

customize.name: Dragon's Bane
customize.desc: A polearm decorated with an entwining golden dragon. Light and sharp, this weapon may very well kill dragons with ease.

customize.name: The Bell
customize.desc: A heavy greatsword. A clock is embedded within it, though its internal mechanisms have long been damaged.

value.text:
ATK is increased by <color=#36ffff>12%/15%/18%/21%/24%</color> . After the equipping character creates a Shield, they gain "Pathfinder's Light" for 20s: Increases your active party member's DMG by <color=#36ffff>10%/13%/16%/19%/22%</color> for every 1,000 ATK the equipping character has, up to a maximum of <color=#36ffff>26%/34%/42%/50%/58%</color> . Additionally, when the equipping character creates a Shield, they will also gain "Guide's Contentment": Restores <color=#36ffff>14/15/16/17/18</color> Elemental Energy to the equipping character. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 14s, and can also be triggered when any type of chest is opened outside of combat. The equipping character may trigger this effect even when they are an off-field.
Hexerei: Secret Rite: When your own Hexerei character is off-field in the party, they will also gain 50% of the DMG increase from Pathfinder's Light.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Artful Device Fragment
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
An intricate device once known as the "Seven Tools of the Great Thief." Rumors claim it was created by the legendary thief, Reed Miller.
Just as the first Treasure Hoarders came from all walks of life, this combination of tools meant for different purposes was designed to break down artificial boundaries, regardless of whether they were chains or borders.
It should be noted that there are more than seven tools, its just that people are accustomed to using seven to describe anything numerous. Perhaps it is for the same reason that the world is believed to have only seven forms of order.

materials.name: Faded Flaming Hilt
materials.desc:
The hilt remains of a flaming sword once wielded by a Domain Keeper.
A sword of blazing fire was once the symbol of protection. Empowered by the authority of "Space," it sealed the boundary between eternity and ephemera.

materials.name: Broken Drive Shaft
materials.desc:
The drive shaft of a Landcruiser destroyed in battle.
Even the most precise craftsmanship cannot withstand excessive wear, just as the most lofty ideals cannot bring back those who've died in vain for someone else's cause. Moreover, mass-produced components can hardly be called precise, and mass-produced ideals can hardly be considered true ideals.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Artful Device Replica
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
Just as the legendary thief's tools have been imitated by countless others, so has his name.
In a sense, it was not the people who thirsted for something more who stole Reed Miller's name, but rather Reed Miller who stole the identity that was originally theirs alone. These viewpoints are just two sides of the same coin.

materials.name: Reinforced Drive Shaft
materials.desc:
The reinforced drive shaft of a Landcruiser.
It took countless reports of destruction to bring about this insignificant improvement. In a sense, the administrative system of the Royal Armory Palace is several times more complex than the machinery it builds. After all, even the most advanced Landcruisers don't take months or even years to build.

materials.name: Artful Device Inheritance
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
Word on the street is that the legendary thief, Reed Miller, has been sentenced to death several times, yet he's always managed to escape at the last minute with the help of his friends — and his tools.
In some versions of these stories, several of his followers willingly died in his place for their revered King of Elysium. Naturally, these versions can't compete with the more popular drunken stories full of romance and bliss. Since there has never been a shackle that could restrain the legendary thief, it is only natural to assume that no ending could do the same.

materials.name: Precision Drive Shaft
materials.desc:
The drive shaft of a Landcruiser refined by the Design Bureau.
On the blueprints drawn by the engineers of the north, this unassuming part was once the flawless embodiment of glory and technological advancement, its small metal body encapsulating the wisdom of countless generations. Now it lies in the cold dirt, waiting to be recycled once more.

materials.name: Artful Device Wish
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"The poor, the starving, the wretched, the oppressed! My exiled brothers and sisters!"
"If you, too, have tasted indignities at the cruel hands of fate! If you, too, have wept in the night at the plight of your neighbors!"
"If you, too, have longed for a shelter from fear! If you, too, have dreamed of a world where no tears are shed!"
"Then join us, your brothers and sisters, in breaking the chains of slavery!"
"Let the dead bury the dead, for you will rise up, and with the treasures of the haughty, we will build an Elysium without boundaries!"
